web_dev.title: Guteza Imbere Urubuga
web_dev.description: Ibisubizo bya web bigezweho kandi bikura, kuva ku mpapuro z'itangira kugeza ku mapuroguramu ya web akomeye. Dukora imbuga zisubiza vuba kandi zoroha zihindura abasura abaguzi.

mobile_dev.title: Guteza Imbere Porogaramu za Telefone
mobile_dev.description: Porogaramu za telefone zikora ku buryo butandukanye zitanga uburambe bwiza ku bikoresho bya iOS na Android.

desktop_dev.title: Guteza Imbere Porogaramu za Mudasobwa
desktop_dev.description: Ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga bikomeye kuri Windows, macOS na Linux bituma ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi bikoreshwa neza kandi bitera imbere umusaruro.

seo.title: Kunoza SEO
seo.description: Ingamba za kunoza injin zo gushakisha zishingiye ku mibare zituma urwego ruzamuka, umurongo w'abantu ugwira, kandi kuboneka ku rubuga rwisumbuye.

consulting.title: Ubujyanama bwa IT
consulting.description: Ubuyobozi bwa tekinoloji bw'ingamba gufasha ibigo gufata ibyemezo byizewe ku mpinduka za digitale no gutegura ibikorwa remezo.

custom_software.title: Ibisubizo bya Porogaramu Zihariye
custom_software.description: Guteza imbere porogaramu zihariye zihuje n'ibyo ubucuruzi bukeneye by'umwihariko, kuva ku bikoresho bya automatisation kugeza ku sisitemu zo gucunga ibigo.

security.title: Umutekano wa Siyansi
security.description: Ibisubizo by'umutekano byuzuye kurinda umutungo wa digitale, kwirinda amakuru gutakara, no kwemeza amategeko y'inganda.

data_analysis.title: Isesengura ry'Amakuru
data_analysis.description: Hindura amakuru meza mu bisubizo by'ubucuruzi bishobora gukoreshwa binyuze mu isesengura rigezweho, kwerekana, n'ibisubizo by'ubwenge bw'ubucuruzi.

loading.welcome: Murakaza neza kuri Amoria Tech Global!

home.partners_subtitle: Baizezwe n'ibigo bikomeye ku isi hose.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Umva ibyo ibigo twafashije guhinduka binyuze muri tekinoloji bivuga

testimonials.name: Joseph Nzaramba
testimonials.text: Amoria Global Tech yahinduye rwose uko tubona ikoranabuhanga. Itsinda ryabo ryadushakiye urubuga rutasaga gusa n'ibyo twari twiteze ahubwo rwanabirenza. Kwitabira ibintu byose no kwiyemeza ku bwiza ni ikintu utasanga kenshi.

testimonials.name: Nkurunziza Amos
testimonials.text: Kuva ku mushinga kugeza ku gushyiraho, Amoria yatanze ku buri cyiciro. Batahuye neza ibibazo byacu bya tekiniki kandi bashaka ibisubizo bikura nta nkomyi. Ni umufatanyabikorwa wa tekiniki wizerwa.

testimonials.name: Muneza Charles
testimonials.text: Gukorana na Amoria ni imwe mu myanzuro myiza twafashe. Bahinduye igitekerezo cyacu bakagikora igicuruzwa abakoresha bakunda. Ubuhanga bwabo, ubwihute, n'umuco wo gukora neza birabatandukanya n'abandi twigeze dukorana.

home.trust_subtitle: Twishimira kuba twemezwa n'ibigo bikuru mu Rwanda kubera kwiyemeza kwacu ku buhanga no kwubahiriza amategeko.
home.trust_dp_caption: Twiyemeje amahame yo kurinda amakuru y'u Rwanda

compliance.title: Kwubahiriza amategeko n'imiyoborere
compliance.subtitle: Kwiyemeza kwacu ku mategeko y'igihugu no ku mahame y'inganda bituma dutanga ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga byizewe, bifite umutekano kandi bigaragara.
compliance.ict_title: Ubuyobozi mu ishyirahamwe ry'ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda
compliance.ict_description: Amoria Global Tech ni umunyamuryango w'ishyirahamwe ry'ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda, urwego rw'abikorera ku giti cyabo rushyigikira ibigo by'ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda.
compliance.dp_description: Twiyemeje kwubahiriza amategeko yo kurinda amakuru y'u Rwanda, akurikiranwa n'ikigo cy'igihugu gishinzwe kurinda amakuru.

about.title: Abo Turibo
about.subtitle: Menya byinshi ku ntego, icyerekezo n'indangagaciro byacu.
about.hero_description: Gutangira ejo hazaza hya tekinoloji binyuze mu bisubizo bishya, ubufatanye bw'ingamba, n'imyitwarire idahinduka yo kuzuza ibyiza bya digitale.
about.mission_text: Guha ibigo n'abantu imbaraga binyuze mu bisubizo bya tekinoloji bigezweho bituma habaho impinduka za digitale, gutera imbere imikorere, no gushyiraho agaciro guhoraho mu isi ihuza.
about.vision_text: Kuba umufatanyabikorwa wa tekinoloji w'ibanze muri Afurika no hanze yayo, uzwi ku bushakashatsi, kwizerwa, n'ingaruka zihinduye mu guteza imbere software, cloud computing, n'ibikorwa remezo bya digitale.

objectives.1: Gutanga ibisubizo bya software n'ubujyanama byiza cyane ku isi
objectives.2: Gushyigikira kuboneka kwa digitale binyuze mu mbuga za tekinoloji ziboneka
objectives.4: Gukomeza gushaka ibishya mu AI, blockchain, na tekinoloji ya cloud
objectives.5: Kubungabunga 99.9% ubushobozi bwo gutanga serivisi n'ibyishimo by'abakiriya

about.team_subtitle: Menya abantu b'umwete bari inyuma y'ibisubizo bishya bya Amoria Global Tech

culture.innovation_desc: Twakira tekinoloji nshya kandi dushyigikira umuco wo kwiga no kugerageza uhoraho.
culture.customer_desc: Buri gisubizo dukora cyagenwe n'intsinzi n'ibyishimo by'abakiriya bacu nk'intego y'ibanze.
culture.quality_desc: Tubika amahame yo hejuru mu bwiza bwa kode, umutekano, n'imikorere mu bicuruzwa byacu byose.
culture.impact_desc: Ibisubizo byacu byagenwe kugira ingaruka nziza ku bigo n'imiryango ku isi hose.
